title: Consciousness-based secret space program / bilocating to other planets
plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, is asked about the idea of a secret space programme run through the mind, where people bilocate, meaning they project themselves to be in another place, here other planets, without leaving their bodies. Buchanan answers simply that yes, he has done that, which if true would mean the mind can travel where spacecraft cannot.
